lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly regular grid-like matrix posterior to the branchial region. High-luminance circular clusters are organized into approximately 10 visible vertical columns, with 5 to 7 blobs per column in the mid-lateral section. The spacing is relatively uniform in both the X and Y axes, forming a Cartesian-like alignment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity run perpendicular to the longitudinal axis. Each high-intensity blob is centered within these vertical bands, acting as a nodal point where the band and the horizontal alignment of blobs intersect.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges are visible across the upper third of the flank. These features are defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition, with higher luminance values on the dorsal aspect of the ridge and a distinct shadow (lower luminance) on the ventral aspect.
